content: Inspecting attention values of the attentive reader, we found that in most cases, the model is unable to properly attend to the relevant parts of the text, even when the answer is literally given in the text. A possible explanation is that the model is confused by the large amount of questions that cannot be answered from the text directly, which might confound the computation of attention values.
